EPC Assessments in Edinburgh

Scotland EPC helps Edinburgh landlords, homeowners, sellers and letting agents arrange domestic EPC/RdSAP assessments with clear pricing and a straightforward enquiry process.

Who this is for

Landlords preparing for a new tenancy, homeowners selling a flat or house, letting agents arranging documentation and property managers coordinating compliance work.

Suitable property types

  • Flats, houses, bungalows and maisonettes.
  • Single property or multiple-property quote requests.
  • Optional Legionella assessment when landlord paperwork is also needed.

Edinburgh coverage

Appointments can cover Edinburgh and nearby areas including Leith, Morningside, Corstorphine, Portobello, Musselburgh and wider Central Scotland.

Related services

If you need water-system risk paperwork too, see Legionella risk assessments in Edinburgh. You can also view EPC Glasgow or request the EPC + Legionella bundle.

Edinburgh EPC FAQs

Do you provide EPCs across Edinburgh?

Yes. Scotland EPC supports domestic EPC bookings across Edinburgh and nearby areas, subject to appointment availability.

Can I request a preferred appointment date?

Yes. The quote form lets you request a preferred assessment date and include access notes.

Can an Edinburgh EPC be bundled with Legionella?

Yes. EPC and Legionella risk assessments can be requested together from £100 where both services are practical for the booking.
